comparison.objective: Replace a worn robot-arm pulley and return two long and two short screws to their remembered hole types; candidate finishes installed HELICOILs.
comparison.physical_skill: Fastener removal/refitting, pulley replacement, and memory of hidden screw lengths versus mandrel alignment, controlled hammer impact, and small-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: New pulley installed and each screw length restored to the correct hole versus four safe tang fractures with inserts retained and all debris contained. Screw torque, seating, and damage thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: This is the closest industrial assembly record, but it tests disassembly/reassembly and memory rather than notch fracture, impact control, and loose-tang containment.
